_meta.note: Canonical dimension dictionaries + per-finding assignments + gold relations for the V0 corpus. Source vocabulary is preserved in evidence_terms/term_mappings; these canonical ids are reviewable projections, not truth. Relations marked holdout=true are the hidden benchmark set: they are NOT ingested before retrieval benchmarks run (leakage gate 18F).
_meta.leakage_disclosure: Tensor coordinates consume the curated mechanism/substrate labels. Tensor retrieval therefore measures curation+compression vs raw text; its value BEYOND the labels is measured against the metadata-exact baseline and by the held-out coordinate test, where the coordinate itself is removed.

mechanism.projection_equivalence: Equivalence under a projection/representation conceals differing latent structure (fingerprints, feature geometry, marginals, identity-level views)
mechanism.latent_affordance: Future reachability / mutational affordance as the real object, distinct from current behaviour
mechanism.selective_retention: Principled retention/forgetting of memory items vs recency/arbitrary eviction
mechanism.negative_evidence_reuse: Preserved failures/exclusions become productive inputs downstream (or fail to)
mechanism.recursive_structure_reuse: A successor learner reuses previously learned structure/decompositions
mechanism.transfer_mediation: What carries or blocks transfer across substrates/relations/families
mechanism.memorization_surface: Gains from memorization/format/surface features rather than structure
mechanism.native_vocabulary: Operators/handles must be native to the objects; generic verbs/labels are silent
mechanism.null_model_discipline: Permutation/reference nulls deciding whether signal is object-level
mechanism.confound_conditioning: Stratification/conditioning dissolving or rescuing an effect
mechanism.wrong_population: Statistic measured on one population quoted as a property of another (scope, windowing)
mechanism.unit_of_inference: Statistics computed on the correct unit (lineage, cell, cluster, block)
mechanism.chance_floor_calibration: The attainable-without-reasoning floor/ceiling of an instrument or gate
mechanism.instrument_tautology: The instrument measures itself (classifier=menu, gate-pass rate, exposure x competence)
mechanism.circular_verification: Verification consumes an assumption of the tested claim or a verdict-correlated filter
mechanism.seed_instability: Effect fails replication across random seeds
mechanism.provenance_integrity: Pipeline/data defects as epistemic events (truncation, transport, desync, freeze checks)
mechanism.accessibility_geometry: Navigability/gradient structure of a search landscape (paths, degradation, needles)
mechanism.interface_contract: Consumption paths/interfaces as the binding constraint on what can be used
mechanism.denylist_leak: A denylist/filter admits everything it fails to enumerate; allowlist discipline
mechanism.calibration_anchor: Known-true structure used to validate instruments end-to-end

substrate_class.program_ecology: Executable-artifact ecologies (D-5 search, Ergon generations, seam work)
substrate_class.game_world: Ludus game worlds and stochastic-stopping families
substrate_class.lmfdb_arithmetic: LMFDB arithmetic objects (EC, NF, L-functions, modular/Artin)
substrate_class.action_corpus: Theseus/aporia recorded action-outcome corpus (h4, d2, d3)
substrate_class.residue_corpus: Failure-residue/scrap corpora used for routing and completion
substrate_class.llm_probe_band: LLM probe band / model-zoo profiling instruments

failure_class.scope_inflation: A scope claim treated as a measurement; aspirational scope
failure_class.confound: Effect explained by a lurking variable (conductor, host, missingness)
failure_class.circularity: Conclusion consumed by its own premises
failure_class.wrong_population: Sample quoted as population; windowed sampling
failure_class.instrument_artifact: Artifact of instrumentation, not the world
failure_class.structural_silence: Correct instruments find nothing; silence is structural
failure_class.navigability_collapse: Space exists but offers no navigable paths
failure_class.transfer_failure: Result fails to transfer across families/substrates
